study.title: NISAR for Monitoring Glacier Motion
missing_reproduction_details: Exact reference and secondary acquisition dates and granule IDs
Radar band for the analyzed GOFF files
Equation and assumptions used to convert radar components to mapped speed
Exact glacier mask and ITS_LIVE mosaic/version/epoch selection

bbox_status: Provisional extraction window, not a published exact boundary

availability.known_gcov_control: HTTP 200, 0 hits for a previously used granule
availability.interpretation: Current discovery responses do not establish that the target files are unavailable; a wider catalog/discovery problem is possible.

velocity_comparison.existing_p07: Selected range or along-track offset divided by exact pair duration, m/day; optional spatial filtering and explicit optional stable-terrain bias correction. Other component and radar-plane magnitude are diagnostics.
velocity_comparison.annualization: 365.25 times an m/day component is an annualized component, not horizontal speed or a measured annual displacement.
velocity_comparison.geometry_requirement: For geographic horizontal speed, resolve geographic components using look/along-track geometry and an explicit vertical or surface-parallel-flow assumption; screen conditioning and terrain/layover, and propagate errors. A single view does not independently determine 3D motion.
velocity_comparison.reference_comparison: Use identical masks, spatial support and equivalent physical quantities. A multiyear ITS_LIVE mosaic is a spatial-pattern benchmark, not same-date truth. Prefer independent time-matched image pairs for quantitative evaluation.
velocity_comparison.statistics: Do not tune filtering to reproduce the published maximum; compare maps and robust distributions, retain rejected counts and sensitivity.

next_steps: Recheck official discovery once catalog responses are usable or import identifiable original GOFF files
Inspect file band, acquisition pair, units, offsets and metadata geometry before selecting a velocity model
Obtain an independent glacier mask and a precisely identified ITS_LIVE comparison product
Download only the required area subsets and execute P07 with filtering sensitivity
Produce published-versus-derived map comparison with explicit non-equivalences before any Examples registration
